why: It is a neat design idea: the code and the controls are two views of one thing, which is a rule-based way of drawing sound I can relate to.
content: Weft Loom shows every pattern twice, as controls and as Strudel code, and the code is the song.
evidence: Every pattern of a song is shown twice: as controls and as Strudel code. The code is the song; the controls read it and rewrite it
